data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to send SMS and MMS on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to send SMS and MMS messages to one or multiple recipients. It also checks if the current device is capable of sending SMS.
use_when: You need to trigger SMS or MMS messages from your app
You want to check if the device can send text messages before calling send APIs
avoid_when: You need to send direct background SMS without opening the native messaging app interface
You need to receive or read incoming SMS messages
weaknesses: Direct SMS sending functionality has been removed in newer versions
Relies on native messaging app intents
